description: Apollo Farms aims to build a local solution to help farmers in Bahrain have the best crop rotation plans, suited to their soil and climate.
summary:
Hasad (Arabic for Harvest) is a decision-support tool for farmers in Bahrain to make use of the best crop rotation strategies for their land and climate. This is important for local self sustainability and resilience against extreme weather, changes in temperature, soil, rainfall, etc. 

Hasad does not solve world hunger or reverse climate change, but it does allow local communities and farms to be independent and self sustaining, so that they can thrive and feed their people, even in dark days.
details:
The idea consists of creating an Agent equipped with the right knowledge about crop rotation and the science behind farming, also trained on different images of soil, along with NASA Power and Local Bahrain Meteorological data. The agent, after receiving input from farmers (such as location, soil images, and crops planted for the last 2 seasons) can recommend the best strategy for the farmer to use in order to have a successful harvest while maintaining good soil health. Furthermore, Hasad has a Community page for users to connect with other farmers in the region, to share valuable advice, tips and tricks or questions.

For Hasad's prototype, we are using a simple user interface, so farmers including ones with little technical knowledge or ability, can make use of the platform. Features like voice-to-text, or read-aloud outputs are also included for ease of use. We planned to use python as the coding language, with .csv files of data from NASA POWER and Bahrain's Meteorological data.

We hope, when fully developed, that Hasad can help local farmers in Bahrain. As many farmers had to learn from trial and error, and years of experience, Hasad makes sure not another drop of sweat goes to waste. It helps the very people who are the source of the food on our table. Connecting them with not only other knowledgeable farmers, but also combining data and strategies to give them an educated recommendation for crop rotation, makes sure the local community and its farmers can have peace of mind every season.
